speaker: narrator
text: Mum called. No answer. Lili was too deep in her game. So Leo did what big brothers do — he shook her chair to get her attention, and bumped her Nintendo right off the table and onto the floor. Lili lost the game she was about to win. "LEO!" she yelled. And just like that, the two of them were fighting.

speaker: narrator
text: said Mum. Then Dad came out of the office.

speaker: dad
text: "Come on — let's just get this settled."

speaker: narrator
text: What nobody noticed was this: when the Nintendo hit the floor, it cracked... and that crack sent a tiny secret signal — zzzt — far, far away.
